jobs.description:
We are looking for a Domain Architect to join our Business Engagement and Platform Solutions team, where you will take domain ownership of the application and platform architecture and drive alignment across our architecture practices.

About the job

The role combines architectural ownership with close business engagement. You will define and maintain the target architecture for applications and platforms, contribute to solution design together with our solution architects and delivery teams, and act as a trusted architectural advisor to the business areas you support.

Your key responsibilities

• Take domain ownership of Orifarm's application and platform architecture, including current state, target state and the roadmap between them

• Engage closely with business stakeholders to understand their processes, priorities and ambitions, and translate these into application and platform solutions

• Drive the architecture forum by setting the agenda, preparing decisions and ensuring alignment across the solution, data, integration and infrastructure architecture practices

• Support solution architects and delivery teams through design reviews, architectural guidance and joint solution design

• Develop and maintain reference architectures, design patterns and architectural standards for the application and platform domain

• Drive simplification of the application portfolio through consolidation, lifecycle management and modernization of key applications

• Support the evaluation, selection and integration of new applications and platforms, ensuring that they can be operated and maintained sustainably

Who are you?

We are looking for a pragmatic and business-oriented architect who is comfortable moving between technical design and stakeholder dialogue. You communicate clearly, and you create alignment through collaboration and professional credibility.

We imagine your profile includes:

• +5 years of experience within solution, application or platform architecture, or a background as a senior developer, lead engineer with relevant architectural experience

• Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into concrete application and platform solutions

• Good understanding of cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, as well as ERP ecosystems and modern integration patterns

• Experience facilitating architectural decisions across teams and disciplines, for example through design reviews or architecture forums

• Experience from a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, life science or medical devices is an advantage

• Knowledge of architecture frameworks is an advantage, with emphasis on practical application rather than formal certification

• Professional proficiency in English. Danish or German is an advantage

Who are we?

You will be part of Business Engagement & Platform Solutions, a function of approximately 40 colleagues across three business-aligned solution teams as well as architecture and integration practices with direct reference to the VP of Corporate IT. Moreover, you will join an organization where IT plays a central role in enabling the business strategy, driving commercial outcomes.

The role offers clear ownership of an architecture domain, close cooperation with senior business stakeholders, and the opportunity to help shape our architecture practice as our organization scales.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

jobs.occupation: Portfolio & Capacity Manager for Systematic's Group IT Strategy
jobs.description:
Portfolio & Capacity Manager for Systematic's Group IT Strategy

Can you bring clarity and control to a fast-moving portfolio, making capacity visible, commitments realistic, and decisions easier to steer?

The job

Group IT (GRIT) is Systematic's internal IT function. It supports all business units with infrastructure, systems, integrations, and governance. As Portfolio & Capacity Manager, you will keep our IT portfolio governed, visible, and deliverable, and give the organisation a clear picture of whether commitments match available capacity.

This role sits close to the top of the organisation. The portfolio and capacity overview you maintain is used directly by our CIO and senior leadership to decide what Systematic takes on next, and what is delayed. The accuracy of your work has a direct bearing on the quality of those decisions.

Some of your key responsibilities will be to:

• Own the live overview of who is working on what and how much capacity is available, by collecting, validating, and maintaining data in Excel, Power BI, or similar tools

• Assess new project requests together with the Enterprise Architect and the Director, so we understand what committing to new work would mean for the portfolio

• Onboard new project managers into our governance model, help them get started properly, and keep documentation consistent across the portfolio

• Support the handover of projects from planning into delivery and operation, so nothing crosses over undocumented

• Prepare decision-ready material for the steering committee, run the meeting cadence, and follow up on decisions and actions

Joining the team

The portfolio machinery you will operate is still being created, and you will help shape it. Our ambition is to mature the portfolio into a transparent and trusted view of what is underway, what will be delivered and when, and the value it creates. This will enable clearer communication with the business, while strengthening follow-through within IT and ensuring that capacity is aligned with demand so commitments can be delivered efficiently and to a high standard.

You will become part of the GRIT Strategy team, a small group where specialists and project managers work closely together to keep our internal strategy on track. Reporting to the Director of Group IT Strategy, you will take over a running portfolio process from an interim consultant and work closely with project managers, the Enterprise Architect, and GRIT leadership.

The team is based in Aarhus. If you are located in Copenhagen, we are open to discussing a hybrid arrangement, but you should expect regular presence in Aarhus (6–8 days per month).

Your qualifications

The most important thing you bring is solid experience from an IT portfolio office - where you have supported IT project delivery, system implementations, IT operations - combined with strong analytical skills and hands-on experience with Excel and Power BI, or similar tools, to build and maintain reliable overviews (experience with Jira is an advantage). Additionally, we expect that you have:

• A good understanding of project management and agile ways of working

• Strong communication skills and the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders

• Comfort exploring AI tools, like Claude, to work smarter and improve how we report and prioritise

• Fluent English; Danish is an advantage

Personally, you enjoy diligent, hands-on work and take pride in keeping information complete, consistent, and current. You are comfortable following up with stakeholders when inputs are missing or unclear, and you thrive as a senior specialist who takes ownership of your domain and leads through sound judgement, structure, and attention to detail.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables, and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Nanna Holmann Opstrup, Director of Group IT Strategy.

jobs.occupation: Are you at your best when others are winding down? Join NORMAL's evening team in Hedensted
jobs.description:
A busy warehouse doesn't stop when the afternoon ends and neither does the team at NORMAL's warehouse in Hedensted.

We are looking for reliable and motivated warehouse employees who want to become part of the evening shift.

This job is for you if you enjoy an active workday, like having clear goals and take pride in delivering a stable performance – shift after shift.

You will become part of a team where everyone has an important role. We depend on each other, which means reliability, responsibility and a positive attitude really matter.

What will you be doing?

Your main tasks will include:

• Picking and packing goods using a handheld scanner

• Handling and moving goods throughout the warehouse

• Operating a runner – previous experience is a strong advantage

• Maintaining an efficient and consistent work pace

• Helping your team achieve the evening's targets

The work is physical and the pace is high, so you should enjoy an active job where you are on the move.

What makes a great NORMAL warehouse employee?

It's not only about being fast.

It's about being consistent.

We are looking for colleagues who:

• Show up reliably and are ready to work

• Deliver a stable effort throughout the entire shift

• Are flexible when tasks and priorities change

• Take responsibility for their own work

• Understand and respect performance expectations

• Can receive feedback professionally and use it to improve

• Work efficiently without compromising quality

• Support their colleagues and contribute to the team

Previous warehouse experience, especially within picking and packing, is preferred. Experience operating a runner or similar warehouse equipment is a significant advantage.

You will always know what is expected

NORMAL's warehouse works with clear picking targets and performance expectations.

Productivity and work pace are followed throughout the shift. This creates transparency: you know what is expected, how you are performing and where you can improve.

For the right person, that's motivating.

We expect you to take feedback seriously, take ownership of your performance and work towards delivering consistent results.

In return, you get a workplace with clear expectations and the opportunity to show what you can do.

Your working hours – Evening Shift

Monday – Thursday: 15:00 – 23:00

Friday: 14:30 – 22:00

Your shift includes a 20-minute paid break and a 30-minute unpaid break.

What do we offer?

• DKK 173.60 per hour

• Holiday pay, pension and optional-choice account (Fritvalg)

• Employment according to applicable collective agreements

• An active job where no two shifts feel slow

• Clear goals and ongoing feedback

• Great colleagues and strong teamwork

• Experience from a large and growing company

• Possibility of long-term employment for candidates who consistently perform well

Ready to become part of the evening team?

If you're the person your colleagues can rely on – someone who shows up, stays engaged, takes responsibility and delivers a consistent effort – we want to hear from you.

Apply today and show us what you can bring to the team.

Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

Working through JKS

As a temporary employee through JKS, you are employed under applicable collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and timely salary payments.

Temporary employment also gives you valuable experience and can open the door to permanent opportunities. Many companies recruit directly from their temporary workforce, making this a great opportunity to demonstrate your skills and reliability.

Are you passionate about finding new drug opportunities? Do you love understanding disease biology to guide the best possible drug design? Are you a seasoned professional and looking for the next step?

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and expanded portfolio. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Ascendis Pharma is expanding our Product Innovation department and searching for an Associate Director to help drive the future pipeline and the company’s growth towards 2030 and beyond.

The Product Innovation department’s primary objective is to conduct analysis and propose new potential products for the company pipeline. With Patients in mind, new lead finding is based on thorough analysis which typically includes disease biology, unmet medical need, market assessment, competitive intelligence, FTO and assessment of path to FiH. With “Science” as a fundamental corporate value, analysis is rooted in a deep biological understanding of the disease, available (pre)clinical data, Mode of Action across modalities/lines of treatment and the impact a given molecular design/TPP will achieve. • Identification of new drug candidates and indications of interest

• In-depth analysis of diseases, treatment guidelines, competitive environment, how different MoA will affect the disease pathology, market and patents into final reports

Beyond contributing to the successful delivery of the Danish Hydrogen Backbone, we are looking for someone who is motivated by the opportunity to become a long-term part of Energinet and help shape Denmark's critical energy infrastructure for years to come.

Lead electrical engineering in a landmark energy infrastructure project

As part of the Engineering department in Gas Transmission, you will serve as the Electrical Engineering Discipline Lead for the Project Danish Hydrogen Backbone project.

You will play a key role in the development of the electrical systems for the project's hydrogen stations, where hydrogen will be received, regulated and transported safely. Acting as a key technical authority, you will contribute throughout the entire project lifecycle, from detailed design and technical clarification to construction, commissioning and handover to operations.

You will join a multidisciplinary project environment, working closely with specialists in Instrumentation, SCADA, Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Technical Safety and Asset Management, as well as Energinet's international EPCM partner and other external consultants.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the technical solutions in a project where quality, safety and long-term reliability are critical to success.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
acting as the Electrical Engineering Discipline Lead throughout the design, construction and commissioning phases

• 
reviewing and approving technical solutions, drawings and engineering documentation

• 
defining technical requirements and documentation standards

• 
ensuring robust electrical solutions, including power supply systems, UPS, control panels, EMC, cable segregation, earthing and lightning protection

• 
contributing to transient studies, emergency shutdown (ESD) strategies, Cause & Effect philosophies and system integrity

• 
participating in FAT, SAT, commissioning and site supervision activities

• 
ensuring compliance with applicable legislation, industry standards and ATEX requirements

You bring experience from large-scale and technically complex process or energy facilities

We are looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer who has a proven track record of working on large-scale technical infrastructure projects and thrives in multidisciplinary environments where engineering disciplines, regulatory requirements and multiple stakeholders must come together.

You have at least five years of hands-on experience with the design, construction and commissioning of electrical installations at major process, energy or industrial facilities operating under the ATEX Directive. You are accustomed to taking technical solutions from concept through to safe, reliable and operational installations, with practical experience across the entire project lifecycle – not just the design phase.

Your background may come from industries such as Power-to-X, refineries, biogas, oil and gas, process manufacturing or other large-scale energy and process facilities. Your specific industry background is less important than your experience delivering projects of a comparable size and technical complexity to the Danish Hydrogen Backbone.

In addition, we expect you:

• 
have extensive experience with electrical installations in ATEX environments

• 
have a solid understanding of Danish legislation, industry standards and regulatory requirements relevant to electrical installations

• 
have experience performing technical reviews and preparing engineering documentation within complex EPC or EPCM projects

• 
work in a structured and systematic manner and are comfortable taking technical ownership

• 
communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing

• 
are eligible to obtain Danish security clearance

• 
hold a valid Category B driving licence

Danish does not need to be your native language. However, we expect you to have previous professional experience working in Denmark and to be familiar with the Danish regulatory framework and industry standards applicable to major technical facilities.

Join one of Denmark's leading engineering teams

You will become part of the Project Engineering department in Gas Transmission – a multidisciplinary engineering team comprising specialists in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering and Instrumentation.

You will join a collaborative and highly technical environment where knowledge sharing, professional sparring and engineering excellence are integral to the way we work. At Energinet, you will have the opportunity to continuously develop your expertise through technically complex projects, internal specialist networks and close collaboration with some of the industry's most experienced engineers.

The position is based in either Ballerup or Egtved. During the current phase of the project, you should expect to spend one to two days per week at the project office in Ballerup, as well as undertaking occasional international travel to collaborate with project partners.

Ready to help shape the future of energy infrastructure?

At Energinet, you will become part of an organisation with a long-term perspective, where the solutions you help develop will play a vital role in Denmark's energy system for decades to come.

If you are motivated by technically complex projects, engineering excellence and the opportunity to contribute to the green transition through the development of critical energy infrastructure, we would love to hear from you.
